## Body

Security verdict: PASS WITH NOTES

PR: #155
Head: 08f74822302742c63614f87479f1158918718161
Scope: all20 PR-owned file deltas against merged main cee011387937c7881318c98d86014526d94f2ca7.

No high-confidence new security vulnerability found.

Verified boundaries:
- Daemon composition injects the trusted pij_harnesses::proc::observed_start reader (daemon/lib.rs:429-434). macOS checks returned PID; Linux reads process-specific /proc and checks Tgid. Local/UTC strings derive from one start snapshot and its contemporaneous offset. Failed reads/conversions return None, with no ps fallback (harnesses/proc.rs:162-184,233-271).
- Exact-PID discovery compares record PID, observed local start and recorded UTC start. Key selection requires matching start/PID domain and exactly one token (transport/uds.rs:177-192,417-451).
- Endpoint key is (seat.id, msg_id, seat.proc, seat.pane). It does not include sender/body/project, but caches only the endpoint: deliver repeats harness/command/acceptance gates and builds the current message payload, rather than inheriting another actor's authorization.
- Entries are consumed under the mutex before awaits, then a fresh UTC start comparison is made. Eligibility is5s and cardinality64; expiry cleanup is lazy and retained bytes have no separate cap (uds.rs:101-117,197-242,320-378).
- Existing daemon bearer/peer-route restrictions, registration host/session checks and role/project routing are unchanged; no new privileged launch or authority grant.

Material inherited limits:
- Named PID/start observation is NOT authentication of the connected socket's OS peer. No connected-peer PID credential check or socket-path ownership/symlink validation exists here. Session-record paths are followed and token/message data transmitted after connection (uds.rs:299-310,656-683). These safeguards were also absent on main; no PR-owned attacker-input path establishing a new exploit was found.
- The fresh start read precedes reply-socket binding/frame construction/async connect, so it does not eliminate check-to-connect or socket replacement races. Existing pane fallback can select another uniquely matching live process after exact-PID failure. Start identity retains whole-second precision.
- Source tests have positive discovery/delivery and negative stale-start/dead-peer/different-message controls. The cached witness checks message ID, not exact body or OS-peer identity. macOS production reader remains source-only under Linux CI here; reported scoped macOS clippy was not rerun.

Evidence: exact-head CI42376556663 and latest Delivers42376884590 independently verified SUCCESS; GitHub reports CLEAN.
